# User story template

Copy into the catalogue or a feature document; assign a new stable ID.

## US NN Descriptive title

- Actor and authorized scope:
- As this actor, I want this behavior, so that this business outcome occurs:
- Source and whether source-derived or newly requested:
- Trigger, frequency and business calendar:
- Main workflow and expected outcome:
- Exceptions, ambiguity and human decisions:
- In-scope and deferred behavior:
- Requirement/scenario links:
- Business owner and unresolved configuration inputs:

Acceptance must include a positive outcome and a meaningful adverse case. Do not equate sending a response with completing the business obligation.
